testcase.name: daemonStatus does not disturb probe classification()
daemonStatus sends METHOD_STATUS with empty params and coerces a Gson-Double reply to Loaded()
daemonStatus defaults modelPullStatus, nulls absent optionals, and zeroes an empty repos array()
daemonStatus coerces a junk-but-ok reply to a zeroed Loaded without throwing()
daemonStatus carries the store failure cause when the payload has storeFailure, and null without it()
a storeFailure object without a usable cause is still shown as a failure()
daemonStatus maps an unreachable daemon to the distinct Stopped state()
daemonStatus maps a framed error reply to Unavailable()
